hero_paragraph: Full Stack developer intern, working with Python, Django and React/TypeScript. I am interested in generative AI and like to learn by building practical solutions: integrating AI models into web applications, measuring the results and validating what the AI delivers.
about_paragraph:
At 19 years old, I am a Computer Science student at UNINASSAU, in the fourth semester, and a Full Stack developer intern at Profort ERP. There I build features for a supermarket ERP with Python, Django, Django REST Framework, React, TypeScript and MySQL, in the inventory, sales, tax (NF-e/NFC-e), POS, users and permissions modules. Today I work on pricing and promotions.

I graduated as an Internet Computing Technician from SENAI CIMATEC and attended technical high school on a SESI/SENAI scholarship. Before the internship, I worked for a year as an IT support technician.

I am interested in Generative Artificial Intelligence and like to learn by experimenting. In LucraFood, my personal project, I integrated vision models into a web application, compared models, evaluated the results against an answer key and implemented validation mechanisms.

I am looking for opportunities to keep growing as a developer, especially in projects that combine software development and AI.
